title: Synthetic ground-truth detection benchmark in a real OHRC dark region

noise_model.gain_note: INFERRED (Phase 4A §12): full well 26.6 ke- assumed to map onto the 10-bit full scale at the published saturation radiance -> ~26 e-/10-bit count, ~104 e-/8-bit count (MSB selection). NOT an official published OHRC calibration coefficient.
noise_model.tdi_scope_note: Model is scoped to this product's TDI64 acquisition (product label tdi_stages=TDI64). No TDI-dependent scaling is applied: the available metadata does not justify generalising across TDI settings.

selection_note: Detection threshold calibrated on feature-free control tiles at 5% false-positive rate; tiles selected for low texture and noise-dominated statistics in one dark region.
caveats: Injected profiles are idealised analytic shapes, not real lunar photometry.
Sub-DN amplitudes are a continuous-signal proxy: the delivered product is uint8-quantised.
All tiles come from one dark region of one product; no terrain diversity is measured here.
The generic DoG detector is one choice; absolute rates depend on the detector, relative ordering is the informative result.
Anscombe stabilization uses the INFERRED Phase 4B gain.
LunaPSR produces a DERIVED REPRESENTATION; nothing here proves geological reality or recovers unmeasured photons.
PNG montages are visualization only (per-image 1-99.5% stretch); quantitative results are in summary.csv/metrics.json.
